headline: TCL CSOT showcases prototype of 115-inch television screen with 16K resolution
summary: China's TCL CSOT unveiled a prototype 115-inch television screen with 16K resolution and glasses-free 3D image support. The display is a prototype rather than a commercial product.
why: TCL CSOT is a display panel maker supplying screens to consumer electronics brands, so its display technology affects the TV and panel supply market.
original_headline: TCL CSOT показала прототип 115-дюймового телевизионного экрана с разрешением 16K
